title: Add dsh-context-rescue: the after-the-fact path for a session that is already refused
body:
**What problem it solves.** Every other context tool here works *before* the request is refused.
This one works *after*: when the host has already failed a turn for exceeding the model context
window, the session is normally stranded — the retry builds the same oversized request again, and
the refusal repeats. dsh-context-rescue intercepts that refusal, reads the real window out of the
gateway message (the built-in classifier misses several wordings, including the
`model's context window` one), folds the oldest span of history into a single checkpoint **without
a model call**, rewrites the session surface, and asks the host to retry that step once.

**Why it is more representative than what is already listed.** The existing entries here
(`distill`, `dsh-memory-evolve`, `dsh-sidechain`, `dsh-turn-rewind`) each change how a session is
organised while it is healthy. This is the emergency path for a session that is already dead, and it
is the only one that does not register the `compaction` service slot, so a preventive compactor
keeps working next to it.

**Install.**

```sh
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue.git#v0.2.3
# or, once published: dsh plugin add dsh-context-rescue
```

Two commands (`/rescue`, `/rescue-status`) plus three model-facing tools; four tiers: host
tool-result pruner → host compaction engine → mechanical fold (readable checkpoint that keeps file
paths) → head-and-tail excerpt for a single oversized message.

**Evidence in the repository:** 140 unit tests; a replay through the host's own `Session` class over
216 captured session logs (70 folded, 0 failures); real-app boot gates including the `web` shape;
and a config schema the host validates.

edits.insert: - [dsh-context-rescue](https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue) — Rescues a session the host has already refused for exceeding the context window: reads the real window out of the error, folds the oldest span into one checkpoint with no model call, retries that step once, and reports what it did through `/rescue` and `/rescue-status`.
edits.message: Add dsh-context-rescue to Orchestration, memory, and workflow

edits.insert: - [dsh-context-rescue](https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue) — 抢救已经被上下文窗口拒掉的会话：从错误里读出真实窗口，零模型把最旧一段历史折成一个检查点，重试失败的那一步，并用 `/rescue` 与 `/rescue-status` 报告做了什么。
